name: EasySecure Bulk Product Importer for WooCommerce
author: imminentsoftwares

sections.description:
Got hundreds of products to add to your WooCommerce store? Stop creating them one by one. Import your entire product catalog from a single spreadsheet.

EasySecure Bulk Product Importer lets you bulk upload both Simple and Variable products into WooCommerce using CSV or Excel (XLSX) files. Map your spreadsheet columns to WooCommerce product fields, and the plugin handles the rest — creating products, setting prices, assigning categories and tags, managing stock, and even generating product variations automatically.

Whether you’re launching a new store with 500 products, migrating from another platform, or managing a supplier catalog that updates regularly — this plugin turns days of manual data entry into a few minutes with a spreadsheet upload.

👉 Supports Simple & Variable Products: Import products with multiple attributes like Size, Color, and Material — variations are created automatically.

👉 Smart Field Mapping: Map any column in your file to any WooCommerce product field, including custom meta fields.

Who Is This Plugin For?

EasySecure Bulk Product Importer is built for anyone who needs to get products into WooCommerce faster than the default editor allows.

New Store Owners
Launching a new WooCommerce store with a large product catalog? Store owners love this plugin because they can prepare their entire product list in Excel or Google Sheets — titles, descriptions, prices, images, SKUs, categories — and import everything in one upload instead of creating products one at a time.

Dropshippers & Marketplace Sellers
Dropshippers love the CSV/Excel import workflow because suppliers typically provide product data in spreadsheet format. Upload the supplier’s file, map the columns, and your store is stocked — no copy-pasting product details individually.

WooCommerce Agencies & Freelancers
Agencies building stores for clients love how the field mapping interface handles different file structures. Every client’s spreadsheet is formatted differently — the mapper lets you align any column to the right WooCommerce field without reformatting the file first.

Store Managers & Catalog Teams
Teams managing large or frequently changing catalogs love the bulk approach. Update prices, stock levels, categories, or meta fields across hundreds of products by editing a spreadsheet and reimporting — far faster than opening each product individually in the WooCommerce admin.

Platform Migrations
Migrating from Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce, or another platform? Export your products as CSV, map them to WooCommerce fields using the plugin’s mapping interface, and import your entire catalog without manually recreating every product.

🎯 Import Features

  • CSV and XLSX file support — use whichever spreadsheet format fits your workflow.
  • Simple and Variable product support — import both product types in a single file. Variable products with attributes like Size, Color, and Material are fully supported.
  • Automatic variation creation — define attributes in your spreadsheet and the plugin generates all WooCommerce product variations automatically. No need to create them manually in the admin.
  • Smart field mapping — map any column in your Excel or CSV file to any WooCommerce product field. The mapping interface lets you handle files with any column structure — no strict template required.
  • Stock management — import stock quantities, stock status, and backorder settings directly from your file.
  • Categories and tags — assign products to WooCommerce categories and tags during import. New categories and tags are created automatically if they don’t already exist.
  • Custom meta fields — map spreadsheet columns to any custom meta field for advanced product data, custom plugin integrations, or theme-specific fields.
  • Error handling and validation — the plugin validates your data during import and reports errors clearly so you can fix issues before they reach your store.

🔒 Built for Reliability

  • Data validation on every import to catch formatting issues and missing required fields before products are created.
  • Clean error reporting so you know exactly which rows need attention.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce-based stores — works with any properly configured WooCommerce installation.
  • Requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

4 Steps to Import Your Products

  1. Prepare your file — organize your product data in a CSV or Excel spreadsheet. Include columns for title, description, price, SKU, stock, categories, attributes, and any other fields you need.
  2. Upload your file — go to Product Import > Import Products in the WordPress admin and upload your file.
  3. Map your columns — use the field mapping interface to connect each column in your file to the correct WooCommerce product field. Map standard fields, attributes, and custom meta.
  4. Import — click import and the plugin creates your products, assigns categories and tags, sets stock levels, and generates variations for variable products.

Your products are live and ready to sell.

💡 Tips for Best Results

  • Title and slug should match — ensure your product title and slug columns are consistent for clean URLs.
  • Use a consistent attribute format — for variable products, keep attribute names (e.g., “Size”, “Color”) consistent across all rows to ensure variations are grouped correctly.
  • Start with a small test file — import 5–10 products first to verify your mapping is correct before uploading your full catalog.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-product-importer-bulk-upload/, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Product Import > Import Products in the admin menu.
  5. Upload your Excel or CSV file and follow the column mapping steps.
sections.faq:
Which file formats are supported?

CSV (.csv) and Excel (.xlsx) files are both supported.

Can I import variable products with multiple attributes?

Yes. You can define attributes like Size, Color, and Material in your spreadsheet, and the plugin will automatically generate all the corresponding WooCommerce product variations. No manual variation creation needed.

Does the plugin support custom meta fields?

Yes. During the field mapping step, you can map any spreadsheet column to a custom meta field. This is useful for theme-specific fields, third-party plugin data, or any custom product information you need.

Do I need to follow a specific file template?

No. The smart field mapping interface lets you map any column structure to WooCommerce fields. You can use your own spreadsheet format — you don’t need to reformat it to match a template.

What happens if my file has errors?

The plugin validates your data during import and provides clear error reporting. You’ll see which rows have issues (missing required fields, formatting problems) so you can fix them and reimport.

Will importing create duplicate products?

The plugin creates new products from your file. To avoid duplicates, make sure you’re not importing products that already exist in your store with the same title/slug. For updates to existing products, adjust your file to match existing product slugs.

Does it work with WooCommerce product images?

You can include image URLs in your spreadsheet columns and map them to the appropriate WooCommerce image fields during import.

Is this compatible with Dokan or other multivendor plugins?

The plugin works with any WooCommerce-based store, including those running multivendor plugins like Dokan, WCFM, or MultiVendorX.

Can I import thousands of products at once?

The plugin is designed for bulk imports. For very large files (1000+ products), your server’s PHP memory limit and execution time settings may need to be adjusted. Start with a smaller batch to test, then scale up.

Does WooCommerce need to be active?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to work.
